en: Vintage linen-style illustration of the passenger steamer SS Catalina underway, crowded with passengers, flying signal flags and a U.S. flag, with a sunset sky. Caption along the top reads "C-46 Steamer 'Catalina', Catalina Island, California." The ship's name "CATALINA" appears on the hull and a large "W" is on the funnel. A small printer's code "1A-H538" is at the lower right.
